contextHeader.hintRepo: Once a Git repository is bound, agent task commits go to dedicated branches and can open PRs automatically. Click to open the Code tab.
contextHeader.hintAgents: Agents belong to organizations; an authorization list decides which projects they can join. This is how many agents can see this project.
contextHeader.hintRunning: Some task leases are active, meaning agents are executing right now. Click to open the Governance tab.
contextHeader.hintRules: Context rules are injected as project background when an agent picks up a task from this project. Click to manage.

codeTab.manageHint: Only project maintainers can change the repository binding.
codeTab.unboundHint1: No repository is bound to this project yet.
codeTab.unboundHint2: Bind a GitHub repository so agent task commits can open PRs and enter the approval flow.
codeTab.flowStep1: Agent finishes a task and pushes to the bound repository branch.
codeTab.flowStep2: A PR is created per the repo autonomy level (L2 auto-merges when all evidence passes).
codeTab.flowStep3: PRs requiring human decisions go to the approval queue:
codeTab.hintBinding: Repository binding gives agent code output a destination: work on a branch → push → open a PR → merge per autonomy level. Only project maintainers can change it.
codeTab.hintAutonomy: L0: every step needs human approval. L1: PR is created automatically, merge needs confirmation. L2: auto-merge when all verification evidence passes.
codeTab.hintAgentReview: When enabled, agent output must pass the designated reviewer agent before approval/merge; without one, the reviewer is resolved from the team.
codeTab.unbindConfirmDesc: After unbinding, agent output will no longer be pushed or open PRs, and the stored token is cleared.
codeTab.hintOwner: The GitHub username or organization — the first segment after github.com in the URL.
codeTab.hintRepoField: The repository name — the last URL segment. Together: github.com/{owner}/{repo}.
codeTab.hintBranch: The PR target branch (base), usually main or master.
codeTab.hintToken: GitHub Personal Access Token: create one under GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Tokens with repo scope. Encrypted at rest, write-only, used for pushing code and opening PRs. Optional for read-only public repos.
codeTab.tokenExtra: Prefer a fine-grained PAT scoped to this repository only; revoke it on GitHub if leaked.
codeTab.tokenKeepHint: A token is configured; leave blank to keep it unchanged.
codeTab.tokenKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current token

agentsTab.title: Agent Collaboration
agentsTab.summary: {total} agents can see this project · {explicit} explicitly granted · {inherited} inherited from workspace
agentsTab.noWorkspaceHint: Project has no organization: agents join via organization (workspace) boundary, so this project is invisible to agents.
agentsTab.hintAuthz: Explicit grant: this project is in the agent's authorization list. Workspace inherited: the agent has no project restrictions, so it sees everything in the organization.
agentsTab.hintRuns: This agent's run stats on this project's tasks (last 90 days; ✓ succeeded / ✗ failed are terminal counts).
agentsTab.hintLastRun: The agent's latest run on this project and its result. "Running" means its lease is still active.
agentsTab.hintRole: Job role from the bound role template; it steers task planning inside goal loops

governanceTab.auditEmpty: No audit events for this project
governanceTab.auditNote: Shows latest events related to this project (including its tasks); recall improves once audit writers populate project_id.
governanceTab.hintPr: PRs raised by agents that need a human decision (L0/L1 autonomy or risk triggers) land here, filtered by your management permissions. Handle them from the task detail page.
governanceTab.hintAudit: Key events related to this project (and its tasks): leases, commits, approvals — for traceability and accountability.

activity.hintRuns: Overview of agent execution on this project. Running > 0 means an agent is working on it right now.
activity.hintRunningTasks: Number of tasks with an active lease (an agent is executing and the lease has not expired).
activity.hintWindow: Terminal run counts within the window: runs that reached succeeded count as success; failed/expired count as failure.
activity.hintEvents: Latest key events related to this project (from the platform audit stream) — a quick answer to "what just happened?".

intro.title: What is this page?
intro.desc: The project detail page is the workspace where humans and agents build together. It is organized by concept:
intro.pointTasks: Task List — to-dos and progress for you and your agents; bulk-dispatch tasks to agents
intro.pointCode: Code — the Git repository bound to this project and its PR approval flow
intro.pointAgents: Agents — which AI agents can see this project and what each has done
intro.pointGovernance: Governance — the PR approval queue needing human decisions, plus project audit events
intro.pointRules: Context Rules — project background injected to agents when they pick up tasks

goalLoop.title: Goal Loops
goalLoop.hintTitle: Let an agent work toward a goal round by round: one task per round, the platform plans the next round automatically until done or a guardrail trips
goalLoop.empty: No goal loops yet — create one and let the agent drive toward a goal
goalLoop.note: The next round starts automatically when a loop task finishes; the loop pauses itself on repeated stalls or when the round limit is hit.

statusHint.running: Running: the next round is planned automatically when a task finishes
statusHint.paused: Paused: no new rounds until resumed
statusHint.done: The planner declared the goal achieved
statusHint.limit_reached: Round limit exhausted without a completion claim; resume to continue
statusHint.stalled: Repeatedly blocked (e.g. AI planner failed); waiting for manual action

goalLoop.hintKick: Plan the next round immediately without waiting for a task to finish (fallback when an agent is down)
goalLoop.hintFormTitle: A name to identify this loop in the list
goalLoop.hintFormGoal: The goal to reach; the more specific, the better the agent performs
goalLoop.hintFormDone: What counts as achieved; the planner uses this to decide when to finish
goalLoop.hintFormRounds: Max rounds of auto-generated tasks (guardrail against runaway loops)
goalLoop.hintFormAgent: Pick the executing agent; leave empty to auto-select
goalLoop.hintFormDirector: The director decomposes the goal into a plan and reviews progress; executors are routed automatically by the role each step requires
goalLoop.hintFormTimeBudget: No new rounds after this many hours (guardrail for multi-day runs); the planner paces itself against the remaining budget
goalLoop.hintPlan: Plan-based decomposition: {done}/{total} steps done; the plan is reviewed automatically on failure or exhaustion
goalLoop.hintTimeBudget: Time budget: the loop stops starting new rounds when exceeded and waits for manual action
goalLoop.hintDirector: Multi-agent orchestration: the director plans and reviews; each round task is routed to a matching executor by its required role
